title: feat(studio): object designer field groups, create-mode canvas, and i18n
body:
## Summary
Optimizes the metadata **object designer** toward mainstream low-code conventions and the "AI authors, human confirms + lightly edits" workflow.

- **Field-group (section) management** in the form-designer canvas: create / rename / reorder / delete sections, drag fields between them, collapse-all/expand-all, per-section add, and a review summary (field · required · section counts). Persists as object-level `fieldGroups: [{key,label}]` + `Field.group` (the canvas already read these; this adds the authoring UI).
- **Create-mode canvas**: the designer canvas now lights up during object *create*, so fields can be designed before the first save. Object basics stay editable via the no-selection inspector. Scoped to `object` via `CREATE_MODE_CANVAS_TYPES`.
- **i18n (en-US / zh-CN)**: the canvas + field inspector now localize through the metadata-admin bundle; field-type and category labels reuse the existing `labelZh` / `CATEGORY_LABEL_ZH`.

## Fixes
- **InspectorSelectField crash** on an empty-string option — Radix forbids `Select.Item value=""`. Bridged with an internal sentinel so the `"" ⇄ none` contract holds for all callers. Surfaced by the new Group selector.
- **Raw `fields` JSON on deselect**: canvas-owned keys (`fields`, `fieldGroups`) are now hidden from the inspector's `SchemaForm` fallback.

## Tests
- New: `object-fields-io` group helpers, `ObjectFormCanvas` grouping interactions, `InspectorSelectField` empty-option regression — **33 tests**.
- Full `metadata-admin` suite green (**79**); `tsc` clean; 0 new lint errors.

## Verified live (zh-CN)
Create object → add fields → add/rename/delete sections → assign field to section via the Group dropdown (previously crashing) → collapse-all. Underlying model confirmed: `fieldGroups:[{key:"section_1",label:"Contact Info"}]` + `currency.group:"section_1"` (stable key after rename).

## Follow-ups (not in this PR)
- Dedicated `ObjectDefaultInspector` for curated + localized object basics on the no-selection panel (mirrors `ViewDefaultInspector`).
- AI-draft review/diff mode and a contextual "generate fields" entry point.
